messages:
Sam Richards: Quick sync — I'm proposing we release audit event schema v2 next month. Main reasons: standardize a `event_version` field, remove legacy `user_ip` (moved to pii.redacted_ip), and add `auth_context` for RBAC details. Need alignment on validation and migration plan.
Anika Patel: +1 on version field. Question: do we plan additive-only? removing user_ip will break downstream filters.
Lee Wong: We can support a compatibility adapter at ingestion: if event_version missing treat as v1 and map `user_ip` -> `pii.redacted_ip`. That buys time for consumers.
Priya Nair: For customers using the audit webhook, we need to communicate breaking changes and provide a feature flag for 60 days before hard removal. Can marketing/CS coordinate messaging? @Ryan-CS
Ryan-CS: Yup, I'll draft the customer advisory. Need clear examples of changed payloads and migration steps. Also list which fields are marked deprecated vs removed.
Kate L: Compliance note: removing `user_ip` outright may affect some customers' legal needs. Recommend soft-deprecate for 90 days and keep an export endpoint that contains full PII for enterprise customers under contract.
Anika Patel: Technical: adding `auth_context` — should it be a nested JSON? Suggest flat fields: `auth_role`, `auth_method`, `auth_actor_id` so we avoid deep parsing across languages.
Sam Richards: Good call. Let's keep it flat to simplify validation. Schema snippet for v2:
```
{
  "event_version": "2",
  "event_type": "model.invoke",
  "timestamp": "2024-12-01T15:23:45Z",
  "actor_id": "user:123",
  "auth_role": "admin",
  "auth_method": "sso",
  "auth_actor_id": "svc-account:inferencer",
  "pii.redacted_ip": "203.***.***.10",
  "resource": "/models/llama/serve",
  "outcome": "success"
}
```
Anika Patel: That helps. Validation rules we should enforce server-side: required `event_version`, allowed values map, and schema strictness depending on `event_version`.
Lee Wong: For storage migration: keep raw event blob with schema_version metadata. New downstream queries could use a view that projects v2 fields. We avoid backfilling historical rows.
Sam Richards: Migration steps proposal: 1) deploy ingestion adapter (treat missing version as v1) 2) start emitting v2 alongside v1 for 30 days 3) feature flag to switch default to v2 for new events 4) 60-day customer notice window 5) deprecate adapter and remove v1 after 90 days. Thoughts?
Priya Nair: Timeline looks ok. Add a canary phase: route 5% of production events to v2 only for two weeks to catch issues.
Anika Patel: KMS question: do we want audit events to be signed with our KMS key so customers can validate authenticity? That would be a new capability (and separate from payload encryption).
Kate L: From compliance, signed audit logs are very valuable. But we must ensure keys are rotated and provide a verification endpoint or public key. HSM/KMS integration required.
Lee Wong: Technically feasible: sign a detached signature per event and include `signature_version` + `signature` fields. We'll need to benchmark signing overhead — might add latency. Could also batch-sign if that's acceptable.
Sam Richards: Let's prototype signing in staging for latency. If overhead > 10ms per request we consider async signer or periodic batch signing. Also add `signature_key_id` for key rotation.
Ryan-CS: For customer-facing validation docs, provide sample code in Python/Go to verify signature, sample webhooks, and a migration checklist. I'll own the docs with help from Anika.
Anika Patel: One more: RBAC change risk — adding `auth_role` might expose derived role names; ensure we don't leak internal role mappings. Maybe map internal roles to sanitized role names before emitting.
Kate L: Yes — add `auth_role_sanitized` or ensure `auth_role` is the public mapping. Document mapping policy.
Sam Richards: Action items: @Anika implement adapter + schema changes, @Lee add storage view + signing perf test, @Ryan-CS draft customer advisory & validation examples, @Priya coordinate canary and messaging, @Kate finalize compliance constraints and export policy. Will follow up with a short RFC doc in #eng-security docs channel.
infra-bot: deployment:staging started for schema-adapter v2 canary (build #3421).
Sam Richards: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after the canary metrics. :+1:
